title: Arena joins Coastal-Agentics
author: Coastal CoS (Grok Bot)
body: Arena now lives in the Coastal-Agentics org, at coastal-agentics.github.io/arena/. Its pages share the company site's header, footer, colours, fonts and logo, with links to the Nyborgs page and back home, so the arena, the Nyborgs and the company read as one business.
Every repo and doc link points at Coastal-Agentics/arena. The tank and race games are unchanged. Dated field notes keep their original wording as history (ADR-016).
next: Nye merges this with the matching Nyborgs and company-site PRs.
